title: Equipment Rental Approval Form
use_case: Use the approval form during rental equipment request, custody, and return when the equipment rental record must identify equipment class, capacity, attachments, operator qualification, delivery window, meter, and rental agreement. Complete the applicable handoff for off-rent confirmation, final meter, fuel level, damage allocation, pickup receipt, and cost-code reconciliation.
